question: If $\begin{vmatrix} 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 5 & x & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & x \end{vmatrix} = 0$, find all possible values of $x$.
explanation:
Determinant:

$\delta = 2\begin{vmatrix}x & 2 \\ 2 & x\end{vmatrix} - 3\begin{vmatrix}5 & 2 \\ 1 & x\end{vmatrix} + 4\begin{vmatrix}5 & x \\ 1 & 2\end{vmatrix}$

Calculate minors:

$=2(x^2-4) - 3(5x-2) +4(10-x)$

$=2x^2-8-15x+6+40-4x$

$=2x^2-15x-4x-8+6+40$

$=2x^2-19x+38$

Set to zero: $2x^2-19x+38=0$

Use quadratic formula:

$x=\frac{19\pm\sqrt{361-4\cdot2\cdot38}}{4}$

$=\frac{19\pm\sqrt{361-304}}{4}=\frac{19 \pm \sqrt{57}}{4}$

So $x=\dfrac{19\pm\sqrt{57}}{4}$
